summary_en: This study tests linvoseltamab added to lenalidomide maintenance therapy in people with multiple myeloma. Linvoseltamab is given by intravenous (IV) infusion on a set schedule, and lenalidomide is taken by mouth at 10 mg daily on days 1 through 21 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 24 cycles. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it describes goals of reaching or keeping MRD negativity, controlling disease longer, and extending response, and the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa linvoseltamab añadido al tratamiento de mantenimiento con lenalidomida en personas con mieloma múltiple. Linvoseltamab se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV) según un calendario establecido, y la lenalidomida se toma por vía oral a 10 mg diarios en los días 1 al 21 de cada ciclo de 28 días, por hasta 24 ciclos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; describe como objetivos alcanzar o mantener la negatividad de enfermedad residual mínima (MRD), controlar la enfermedad por más tiempo y prolongar la respuesta, y el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with a triplet or quadruplet initial combination therapy.
Currently on lenalidomide maintenance for 12 months or less, with PR, VGPR or CR but MRD-positive (cohort 1).
Relapse from complete response without meeting IMWG progression criteria (cohort 2).
ECOG performance status of 3 or less, with adequate blood counts and organ function.
Able to give written informed consent and follow contraception rules.
not_for: Prior myeloma therapy beyond the initial IMiD, proteasome inhibitor, anti-CD38 or transplant-based combination.
Receiving other investigational agents, unless the PI decides they do not interfere.
Hepatitis B or C infection, or HIV meeting the listed criteria.
NYHA stage III or IV heart failure, or heart attack or bypass within 3 months.
Active cancer other than myeloma needing treatment in the past 6 months, or neurodegenerative condition or seizure within 12 months.
